objective: Identify real future tasks that can be executed directly from matched successful states at the same earlier repository snapshot, without replaying history authored on the historical branch.

design.future_task: the frozen later issue specification and verifier, backported to the common current snapshot

requirements_for_every_state: current FAIL_TO_PASS verifier applies and passes
frozen future maintainer patch applies at the common snapshot
future FAIL_TO_PASS tests pass after the future maintainer patch
up to 20 frozen future PASS_TO_PASS tests pass
current FAIL_TO_PASS tests still pass after the future maintainer patch

next_stage: Freeze the eligible future-pair list and run the same future-agent prompt independently from all three matched states. If fewer than three future pairs survive, report the feasibility failure and do not claim a symmetric replication.
